mine.basis: Total site WITHDRAWAL (new water, excl. recycled; no seawater in any point) / TOTAL site energy incl. diesel/gas/coal (mines self-generate much of their power, so electricity-only ratios are not comparable: 17-25 L/kWh when only purchased electricity is counted). caveats: Every l_per_kwh is our own division of two company-disclosed figures, so all ratios are marked 'estimated' even though the inputs are company self-reports. Several electricity figures are also derived (Amkor, Lam, Entegris, Foxconn, Inventec) - see each arithmetic string.

Basis differs by type: mines use total energy (incl. diesel/coal/gas self-generation) because much of a mine's power is not grid electricity. All manufacturing types use electricity, consistent with the TSMC 5.25 L/kWh figure. Where a total-energy ratio exists it is given in the arithmetic string and is 3-15% lower.

All defaults are WITHDRAWAL. Consumption is much lower for sites that discharge most water: Grasberg 0.44 vs 7.27, ASE 1.40 vs 5.10. For arid zero-discharge mines (FCX Americas), consumption is about equal to withdrawal. Talison consumption (5.07) is close to withdrawal.

Mines: FCX 'new water withdrawn' includes stormwater (Grasberg 23.8 Mm3 of 65.1). Talison withdrawal is ~97% captured rainwater and swings with rainfall (2.94 L/kWh in 2023 vs 5.47 in 2024). No mining point includes seawater. BHP Escondida (desalinated seawater) was not reachable (access denied). MP Materials publishes water (~154M gal in 2023) but no energy total, so null. Sibelco / The Quartz Corp: no water volume published, so high-purity quartz is null.

PLS point combines water from the PLS FY25 annual report with energy from the Australian Clean Energy Regulator NGER 2023-24 corporate table ('net energy consumed'). Same company and year, different publications.

Rare earths: only Mt Weld (mine + concentrator). Lynas Malaysia separation plant (processing, not mining) is ~18.9 L/kWh (5,254,809 m3 / 278,478 MWh fuel+electricity, FY25), for reference if the app ever models RE refining.
Packaging: ASEH group data include USI (EMS/system assembly), so ASE is a blend of OSAT and assembly. TSMC advanced packaging (CoWoS/SoIC) is not separable in TSMC disclosures.
Equipment and materials company-wide figures include offices, R&D and cleanroom labs, not just production.
Shin-Etsu energy is published only in crude-oil-equivalent kL. The 38.76 GJ/kL conversion is our assumption.
SUMCO water value was read off a web chart, not a data table.
Web search budget ran out. Not researched or not obtained: Applied Materials (403), ZEISS, Air Liquide, Resonac, Central Glass, Quanta (bot wall), Flex (no energy total), Codelco, BHP.
